reviewer.tool: Codex shell inspection, javac/java probes, pinned PlantUML jar, and the supplied diff_one path

helper.integrity_assessment: The supplied path changed or the requested hash was stale before this review began. No binary with the requested hash was found under /private/tmp. Dynamic SVG artifacts and transcripts are truthfully attributed to the observed binary, not to the requested hash. The rejecting additive-width finding also follows directly from the exact implementation source and independent Java measurements, so it does not depend on treating the observed helper as the pinned binary.

documents_and_code_inspected: PlantUML FontStack.java, UFontImpl.java, FileFormat.java, and StringBounderRaw.java at the pinned Java revision

java_model_assessment.font_selection: For a single requested family, FontStack derives the primary Times New Roman AWT Font with the requested face and integer size. UFontImpl returns that same face-aware Font for text measurement.
java_model_assessment.measurement: FileFormat.getJavaDimension invokes FontMetrics.getStringBounds on the complete string, and StringBounderRaw obtains descent from the same resolved Font.
java_model_assessment.boundary: For simple Latin, Greek, Cyrillic, punctuation, and the tested combining sequences, complete-string width is additive over scalar advances. Arabic is not additive because AWT performs contextual shaping; that failure is classified within the account's explicit shaping residue.

generator_reproducibility.defect: scalarUnits rounds each 2048-point AWT advance with Math.round and stores it as u16. Some valid simple-script advances are fractional at 2048 points, so the encoding loses information before Rust scales it to the requested size.

adversarial_additivity_probe.scope_assessment: Rejecting and in scope. Repeated U+0518 has no combining marks, ligatures, contextual shaping, grapheme sequence, or font-stack fallback. Java's whole-string width is scalar-additive to less than 0.0002px, while the checked-in rounded table creates the visible error.

perturbations.result: strict fail outside mechanism; all Times textLength values exact
perturbations.classification: Nested state/container vertical dimensions differ while every text width is exact. This is a state nested-envelope residue, not an additive advance failure.

axes: plain, bold, italic, and bold-italic runs
perturbations.result: strict fail outside mechanism; bold, italic, bold-italic, em-dash, ellipsis, and symbol advances exact
perturbations.classification: Java normalizes U+2013 EN DASH to ASCII hyphen before SVG output while Rust preserves U+2013. The resulting plain-run width difference is a text-normalization ownership gap, not an error in the U+2013 table entry.

axes: combining acute, ring, diaeresis, and grave
plain state and italic arrow faces
perturbations.result: strict fail outside mechanism; all Times textLength values exact
perturbations.classification: The sampled combining strings are additive in this AWT face: Java complete-string and scalar-sum widths are identical. The only SVG difference is the known root-envelope translation.

axes: bold state and italic arrow faces
perturbations.result: strict fail within declared shaping residue
perturbations.classification: For the arrow phrase, Java complete-string width is 81.401367188px while the scalar sum is 102.402725220px, a -21.001358032px contextual-shaping delta. This is explicitly outside the additive-scalar claim and remains preserved.

axes: state titles, ordinary link, self link
perturbations.classification: Java textLength is 582.1141 versus Rust 581.9844 for each state title, and 650.5978 versus 650.4531 for each arrow label. The difference is exactly the generated table's lossy rounding of U+0518.

fixture_shape_and_constant_audit.production_fixture_matches: No fresh fixture stem or fresh label occurs in shipping crates or tools.
fixture_shape_and_constant_audit.old_counterexample_strings: Three old rejecting strings occur in unit assertions. They do not drive production branching, but they are insufficient protection against the independently generated fractional-advance case.
fixture_shape_and_constant_audit.unexplained_constants: The 2048 units-per-em scale has Java extractor provenance. The rejecting defect is not an unexplained constant but the unjustified assumption that rounding every fractional 2048-point advance to integer u16 units remains exact after arbitrary repetition.

verdict_reason: A fresh valid simple-script counterexample disproves the claimed additive-advance invariant. The checked-in range ordering and coverage are complete, but integer u16 compression loses fractional AWT advances and accumulates a measurable error. T14 requires any additive-advance counterexample to reject the mechanism.
